entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse. I... I think I need to return it. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To get started, can I get your name and order number?
Yes, it's Sarah Gable, order number 774-B-91. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I saved up for this... I just feel awful about it.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your order here. You received it on January 7th, about 12 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken... it's just so confusing. I found the whole interface very hard to use. I read the user manual front to back, but I still can't get the sleep cycle tracking to work the way I thought it would. I really expected more, you know? I needed this money for other things, and it feels like a waste.

I understand your frustration completely. When you invest in a premium device, you expect it to be intuitive. I'm just going to place you on a brief hold to review our current return policy for your item. I'll be right back.
Alright, Sarah, thank you for your patience. I've checked the policy, and I have good news. All our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
That's correct. Since you're only on day 12, you are well within that window. I can go ahead and start the return process for you right now and get you a full refund.
Wow, that's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, David. I was so worried. That makes me feel a lot better.

Of course, Sarah. It's my pleasure to help. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's perfect. You've been a great help. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
